overview.more:
Lalbagh Botanical Garden's Top Attractions in Bangalore

Lalbagh Botanical Garden in Bangalore is like a treasure trove of cool stuff! It's a must-visit spot with loads of exciting things for everyone. Imagine a big garden where you can find awesome things, like:

Glass House: This place is super fancy, like a Crystal Palace from London. They throw flower parties here twice a year with tons of colors.

Lalbagh Rock: Picture a huge rock that gives you an amazing view of everything. It's like nature's own lookout spot.

Flower Shows: Lalbagh hosts flower parties on Republic Day and Independence Day. It's like a flower wonderland during those times.

Bonsai Garden: Have you seen those tiny trees that look like they're from a fairy tale? Lalbagh has a whole garden of them!

Palm House: Imagine a fancy old house filled with all kinds of cool palm trees. That's the Palm House for you.

Lotus Pond: There's a pond with beautiful lotus flowers. It's a calm and peaceful spot in the middle of all the excitement.

Kempegowda Tower: This tower is like a cool old building that tells the story of the city's founder. History buffs will love it!

Deer Paddock: Lalbagh has a special place where you can watch deer doing their deer thing. It's like a mini safari for families.

Cactus House: If you're into tough and unique plants, check out the Cactus House. It's like a mini desert in Lalbagh.

Statue of Sri Chamarajendra Wadiyar: Near one of the gates, there's a statue of a Maharaja. It adds a royal touch to Lalbagh.
